item.title: Found Festival
item.description:
Found Festival is an intimate, 2,000-capacity boutique gathering set in the stunning Buckinghamshire countryside. Over the August Bank Holiday weekend, the festival will host over 100 incredible folk, roots, and indie acts across three stages, including This Is The Kit, Stornoway, and The Felice Brothers, alongside non-stop dance and community celebrations.

Because great music goes hand-in-hand with a healthy mind, our team will be on-site all weekend. We are creating a dedicated, safe sanctuary to help you pause, reset, and chat about mental health whenever the festival energy gets a bit too loud. Come enjoy the music, find your community, and let us look after your wellbeing!

item.title: New Wave Pride In Roath
item.description: We are incredibly proud to partner with New Wave Wrestling. As part of our ongoing mission to tackle the stigma around mental health, our team will be live on-site to provide dedicated wellbeing support for both the audience and the performers, ensuring a safe and inclusive environment. The event itself is a high-energy, family-friendly professional wrestling showcase that highlights the brightest rising stars of the Welsh independent scene. Through this unique collaboration, we are thrilled to help make New Wave Wrestling a truly accessible, welcoming, and supportive experience for all.

item.title: Wellnergy 2026
item.description:
Wellnergy Festival is the UK’s leading festival of wellness, bringing together thousands of people for an inspiring day dedicated to health, happiness, and personal wellbeing. Set in the heart of London, the festival features world-class speakers, fitness experiences, live entertainment, mindful workshops, and interactive activities designed to help you feel your best.

Looking after your mental wellbeing is just as important as your physical health, which is why our team will be there throughout the festival. Visit our wellbeing space whenever you need a moment to pause, reset, or simply have a chat. Whether you’re feeling overwhelmed, need a quiet space, or just want to connect with someone who understands, we’re here to help you make the most of your Wellnergy experience.
